name: paperless-ngx-mcp
description: Search, tag, edit and upload documents in your Paperless-ngx instance.
long_description: Exposes the Paperless-ngx REST API to Claude: documents and their versions, tags, correspondents, document types, custom fields, storage paths, saved views, workflows, mail accounts and rules, share links and bundles, notes, trash and tasks. Includes a `triage_inbox` prompt that proposes metadata for inbox documents and applies it after you confirm.

paperless_url.title: Paperless-ngx URL
paperless_url.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance, e.g. https://paperless.example.com

paperless_api_key.title: API token
paperless_api_key.description: In Paperless-ngx: your username (top right) → My Profile → generate token.
